MARTIAN-ROBOTS

3D workspace

Select a source image, then run the readiness check.

Terrain layers Changing it rebuilds the displayed local mesh.

Mouse wheel: dolly · Gamepad: exponential sticks, L1 + left stick vertical inspects/dollies, R2 rises, L2 descends above terrain, L3 resets, R3 focuses rover, Square toggles fullscreen.

Rover model calibration

Values are in scene metres and degrees. They remain unverified until the model-frame audit is complete.

50 cm calibration cube

Red cube centre in scene metres. The cube stays axis-aligned on the surface; cyan +Z arrow is 0° forward.

NASA mesh calibration

Values apply only to the currently loaded PDS mesh product and are stored locally with that product.

Local mesh calibration

Only the locally reconstructed heightfield is affected.

Experimental planetarium calibration

This disabled-by-default 3D path maps the Sol panorama and locally deforms the same planetarium mesh. Only polygons reached by the local stereo grid are tessellated.

Panorama calibration

Only the stereo source-image reference is affected.

        MISSION CONTROL

        Explorer controls

        Navigate the panorama, inspect overlapping source frames, and move through each rover’s mapped locations.

        Mouse & panorama

        Drag
        Look around the panorama.
        Mouse wheel
        Zoom in and out.
        Alt + hover
        Reveal the overlapping image beneath the pointer.
        Click an image
        Open its image information panel.
        Shift + click
        Select or remove one image.
        Shift + drag
        Draw a circular image selection.

        Keyboard

        A / D
        Move the virtual camera left / right.
        W / S
        Move the virtual camera forward / back.
        Q / E
        Move the virtual camera up.
        C
        Move the virtual camera down.
        Space
        Smoothly return the virtual camera to the panorama centre.
        Esc
        Cancel an image selection, close a notice, or close this help.

        Navigation & layers

        Sol stepper
        Change the requested Martian day; loading fetches a new public image set.
        Location stepper
        Move through mapped rover stations, including the adjacent Sol when necessary.
        Location resolution
        Merge or separate nearby rover positions within the active Sol.
        Layer spacing
        Adjust the faux-depth separation of overlapping captures.
        Fullscreen
        Use the upper-right canvas button for an unobstructed view and live HUD feedback.

        GAMEPAD

        Controller mapping

        Standard Gamepad mapping is supported. Analog sticks and triggers use exponential response after their dead zones.

        Left stick · move camera Right stick · look L1 · Instrument Wheel L2 · analog zoom R1 · move up R2 · move down L3 · reset camera R3 · reveal image beneath D-pad · location & resolution Circle · Escape Square · Fullscreen Triangle + D-pad ↑/↓ · layer spacing
        D-pad left / right
        Decrease / increase location resolution.
        D-pad up / down
        Next / previous mapped location.
        Triangle + D-pad up / down
        Increase / decrease layer spacing.
